props.name: box
props.description: Box treatment behind the glyph: - `"tint"` (default): a soft status-colored chip. - `"transparent"`: no box — just the colored glyph. Use on already-tinted surfaces (e.g. inside a colored Alert) so the chip doesn't clash. - `"solid"`: a full status-colored box with a contrasting (white) glyph.

props.name: shape
props.description: Box shape — `"rounded"` (default) or a full `"round"` circle.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. When omitted the box is decorative (`aria-hidden`).
